date_check: DATE CHECK — Left out on purpose: the Shenzhen trilateral summit (19 Nov), the world court's Rohingya ruling day (19 Nov) and Anthropic's IPO debut (19 Nov). Only their 21 November fallout made this page.
footer: Every story was reported in the news cycle of Saturday 21 November 2026; contested claims are attributed. Sources: Reuters · AP · AFP · RFE/RL · CNA · DAZN · UKMTO · BBC

leads.headline: Russian Missiles Fall on Poland; NATO Cries Violation
leads.summary: Two missiles and a suspected drone down on Polish soil during a mass strike on Ukraine; Warsaw calls it a deliberate provocation.

leads.headline: AI Rout Pushes Wall Street Into Correction
leads.summary: The S&P 500 falls 3.7% and the Nasdaq 5.28% as the AI sell-off deepens; the Nikkei drops 5.06% and gold slides almost 4%.

leads.headline: US Envoys See Peace Progress as NATO Debate Resurfaces
leads.summary: Washington and Europe edge toward unity on a peace framework; envoy Kushner says Moscow may accept NATO-style guarantees.

leads.headline: Strike on Kryvyi Rih Kills 2, Injures 42
leads.summary: City chief Oleksandr Vilkul reports two dead and 42 injured, four of them children, in the latest strike on the city.

leads.headline: Saudi Arabia Downs Three Houthi Missiles Over Riyadh
leads.summary: The coalition intercepts ballistic missiles aimed at the capital, and the Houthis answer with strikes of their own.

leads.headline: Tanker Burns Near Hormuz as US Sanctions Iran Oil Trustees
leads.summary: A tanker catches fire north of Khasab and UKMTO warns shipping; Washington blacklists four handlers of Iranian oil revenue.

leads.headline: Young Europe Takes to the Streets
leads.summary: Youth protests over living costs, military spending and the climate sweep Italy, Germany, Switzerland and Britain.

leads.headline: Jury Convicts Man of Sparking Deadly Palisades Fire
leads.summary: A Los Angeles jury finds Jonathan Rinderknecht guilty of starting the fire that devastated Pacific Palisades.

leads.headline: Britain and EU Sign Reset: Food, Carbon, Youth Mobility
leads.summary: Burnham and EU leaders sign three deals in Brussels, including 100,000 youth-mobility places a year on each side, ages 18-31.

leads.headline: Mathematician Says AI Helped Crack the Riemann Hypothesis
leads.summary: Anthropic's Levent Alpöge says he and Claude produced a machine-checkable proof of the 167-year-old problem; experts must verify it.

leads.headline: Kim Tours Factories as Trump Vows 'That Meeting' Will Happen
leads.summary: North Korea's leader inspects industry after the APEC encounter fell through; Trump insists a summit is still coming.

leads.headline: Lauren Price Sweeps the Belts to Become Undisputed Champion
leads.summary: The Welsh star outpoints Michaela Kotaskova unanimously on Friday night to hold every welterweight title at once.
